instruction: Look at twin_fixture.step in NX CAM. Create the same Face and Profile operations for the two parts in twin_fixture.step. Use two MCSs or equivalent work offsets corresponding to G54 and G55. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill reused for both MCS/work offsets. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-13.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
